definitions.gloss: having a fishy or raw smell
definitions.explanation: Smelling of raw fish, meat, or blood; having an unpleasant raw organic odor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{触|さわ}ったら→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生臭|なまぐさ}く⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My hands became fishy after touching the fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{生臭|なまぐさ}い⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The market has a fishy smell from early morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{生臭|なまぐさ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: Squeezing lemon removes the fishy smell.
There was a raw, bloody smell.

notes:
{生臭|なまぐさ}い is a compound i-adjective combining ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw) + ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ (smelling of).

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {生臭|なまぐさ}く
- Noun form: {生臭|なまぐさ}さ

USAGE:
Primarily used for fish, but also applies to raw meat, blood, or any uncooked animal product. Often describes an unpleasant smell that people want to eliminate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生臭|なまぐさ}い⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ - fishy smell
- {生臭|なまぐさ}い⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ - fishy-smelling hands
- {生臭|なまぐさ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ - to remove the fishy smell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生臭|なまぐさ}い vs. ⟦{青臭|あおくさ}い→青臭い：06821_aokusai⟧: {生臭|なまぐさ}い is for raw fish/meat; ⟦{青臭|あおくさ}い→青臭い：06821_aokusai⟧ is for raw vegetables/grass
- {生臭|なまぐさ}い vs. ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧: ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ is generic bad smell; {生臭|なまぐさ}い specifically means raw organic smell
